$comment: Light Time state rules. OK = inside the crewmember's baseline band. WATCH = outside the band once (silent). ALERT = any 'alert' condition below (red, pulse, beep until acknowledged). Every number is traceable to the NASA source named in 'source'. Baseline bands are per crewmember (see crew-seed.json).

heart_rate_rest.alert: resting HR > baseline + 20 bpm for 3 consecutive days
heart_rate_rest.source: OCHMO Exercise Overview brief (TB-031); Cardiovascular evidence report

blood_pressure.cadence: cuff at check-in and on demand
blood_pressure.watch: outside pre-flight range on one cuff reading
blood_pressure.alert: outside pre-flight range on two cuff readings

respiratory_rate.alert: > 20 at rest with CO2 above 4.5 mmHg or symptom

core_temperature.source: Clinical fever threshold; NASA-STD-3001 V1 3004 vital-sign trending

radiation_daily_dose.source: NASA-STD-3001 Rev C career limit; OCHMO Radiation Protection brief (TB-020); DONKI

sleep_hours.source: HRP Sleep evidence report; OCHMO Circadian Desynchrony brief (MTB-009)

mood.alert: <= 2 with a symptom or sleep ALERT
mood.source: OCHMO Behavioral Health brief (TB-016); Behavioral Medicine evidence report 2025

reaction_time_pvt.alert: mean > baseline + 30% with sleep WATCH or ALERT
reaction_time_pvt.source: CSA PRET dataset (PVT files) for distributions; HRP Sleep evidence report

blood_glucose_fasting.source: Standard clinical ranges; OSDR Inspiration4 OSD-575 metabolic panel

hydration.alert: under target for a week with urine colour >= 5 or renal symptom
hydration.source: OCHMO Food and Nutrition brief (TB-013); Renal Stone risk page

exercise_minutes_week.alert: 40% drop from prescribed for two weeks

vo2max_pct_preflight.source: OCHMO Exercise Overview brief (TB-031); Aerobic and Muscle evidence report 2024

strength_pct_preflight.source: OCHMO Exercise Overview brief; Aerobic and Muscle evidence report 2024

space_weather.watch: DONKI SEP event in the last 24 h (shelter advisory)
space_weather.source: DONKI SEP/FLR/RBE; OCHMO Radiation Protection brief
